integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic, live-action, a static wide shot frames a cool, desolate night wilderness on the outskirts of Hohhot — a vast still grassland under a dark hazy sky, thin mist drifting low over the ground, faint stars glimmering through the haze. For the first three seconds the scene is instrumental only: a sparse guzheng lead line plucks over a deep overtone-singing-style low hum and warm, soft electric piano chords; no vocals yet. [Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the camera holds the same wide frame with a very slow, subtle push-in as a soft, breathy female voice (S1) begins to sing the chorus once, unhurried: <d>[English] The night of Hohhot, so deep, so deep / Even the stars did not notice, I did not notice / The night of Hohhot, so deep, so deep / Even the mist did not hear, I did not hear.</d> As she sings, the mist curls gently across the grassland and starlight shimmers faintly; the arrangement stays on guzheng, low strings with overtone texture, and light electric piano, with no drum kit, in slow 4/4 at roughly 66–70 BPM. [Shot 3] At 00:13.000, the voice ends and the shot continues its slow push-in over the still landscape as a short instrumental echo of Phrase B on guzheng and electric piano fades out, dissolving into a final moment of breathing silence; the clip ends in quiet stillness with no on-screen text.

overall_soundscape: Low wind moves across an open grassland at night with a faint, cold hush of drifting mist. The guzheng plucks softly, a deep overtone hum sustains underneath, and the final seconds settle into near-silence with only the faintest breath of wind.

non_diegetic_music: The song itself is the only music: slow 4/4 at roughly 66–70 BPM, built on guzheng lead, overtone-textured low strings and hum, and light warm electric piano with no drum kit; it fades on a short instrumental echo into silence at the end.
